changelog: Added a Show HUD switch (Interface settings, /togglehud command and key binding) that hides the whole HUD. Fixed the HUD reappearing after closing the pause menu while hidden, the HUD staying hidden after a failed map / keybinds / game settings open, a stuck keybinds / game settings screen, a lingering mouse cursor when the resource is restarted with a menu open, and the community hub answering before all pages loaded. Update checks now go through noxcore.me.
